The opportunity also has an emphasis of utilizing Gen AI and latest technological advancements in the electronic medical records and telemedicine systems

source_rows.title: Exterior Lights

raw.title: Exterior Lights

details.description:
- Localizing the production of finished automotive lights to supply to the local OEMs in Saudi Arabia. Products include exterior light for vehicles e.g., headlights, taillights, braking strips and fog lights.
- Automotive-grade lights technology can be used to manufacture lights for other vehicles e.g., bus, trucks.
- This opportunity occurs in tier-1 manufacturing phases, prior to the assembly/distribution.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Meet demand from OEM projects, with proximity to OEMs.
• Develop automotive-grade light manufacturing capabilities in Saudi Arabia.
• Leverage low raw material (plastic) prices in Saudi Arabia.
• Leverage capabilities for other vehicle types (e.g., bus).

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Localization of OEMs production in Saudi Arabia, with confirmed projects by Lucid, Ceer – expected production of 300,000+ vehicles a year. - 17% CAGR estimated for Saudi Arabia demand (mainly from automotive applications). - Increasing regulations regarding the use of effective lightings in automobiles for increased safety. - Increasing demand for premium segment vehicles, with advanced lighting technologies.

source_rows.title: Outside Plant Optical Distribution Network (ODN)

raw.title: Outside Plant Optical Distribution Network (ODN)

details.description:
- Description: localize assembly of outside plant optical distribution networks (ODNs), which the portion located outside buildings or underground responsible for distributing optical signals from the point of presence to the customer premises. The ODN specifically has five segments: feeder fiber, optical distribution point, distribution fiber, optical access point, and drop fiber.

- Product: ODNs include key passive equipment, such as splitters or fiber distribution cabinets, and are the essential path for PON data transmission.

- Customers: potential key clients include telecoms operators and data center players (for data center networking).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point: • Large potential for import substitution (Saudi Arabian demand mostly supplied by foreign producers).

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Increasing local demand in relevant sectors: telecoms operators' fixed network coverage expansion and data center construction. - Localization of spend in optical distribution networks by STC, PIF's Portfolio Company (approximately SAR 400M 5-years' cumulative demand).

source_rows.title: HVAC components

raw.title: HVAC components

details.description:
Establishing one or more scroll compressors and motors assembly plants (separately) to address the local supply gap of ~5M scroll compressors and ~18M motors per annum used in HVAC systems

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of scroll compressors includes having automation and robotics for mass production
- Motors facility includes having automated assembly lines for 3 types of motors: blower, swing and condenser fan motors

cardsData.stat:
SAR 0.8-1.0B (USD 0.2-0.3B)
[For a facility of 2M compressors and 8M motors per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to close gap in HVAC supply chain, as currently all compressors and motors are imported
• Significant potential to expand to other industries with high demand for compressors and motors such as automotive, oil and gas, water desalination and petrochemicals
• Ability to benefit from the “Standard Incentives Program” and receive funding up to 35% of the initial capex (capped at SAR 50M)
• Current Market
• Market fully supplied through imports; no local producer of compressors and motors
• Key global players include Gree (China), Mitsubishi Electric (Japan) and Danfoss (Denmark)

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative demand of ~86M units scroll compressors and ~288M units of motors in Saudi Arabia for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

raw.title: Coffee beans production and primary processing

details.description:
- Saudi Coffee Company has launched its brand ‘Jazean’ with the aim of becoming the leader and global custodian of Arabica coffee production and marketing
- An opportunity exists to produce and supply coffee beans, mainly produced in the Jazan, Aseer, Al Baha of Saudi Arabia
- The private sector is expected to harvest the beans and conduct initial processing, including drying and initial milling and polishing of coffee beans

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Local manufacturing of coffee beans is aligned with Vision 2030 by diversifying non-oil revenues
• Lower cost as compared to importing coffee beans
• Access to the largest market in the Middle East

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The Middle East coffee market is valued at $175 million (2025) and is expected to reach $290 million with a CAGR of 10.61%

source_rows.title: Centrifugal pumps

raw.title: Centrifugal pumps

details.description:
- Specifications:
1. Setting up a centrifugal pumps manufacturing plant to cater water and wastewater sector requirements across the local and regional markets.

Key products (HS code):
-Pumps, for liquids (841319)
-Centrifugal Pumps (841370)
-Pumps, parts (841391)

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• High potential due to localization of pump manufacturing at ~22% in 2021.
• Pumps is part of the Saudi Arabian National Industrial Strategy.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia Centrifugal Pump and Service & Spare Parts market size is projected to grow at CAGR of 4.5% (2021-2030) driven by O&G, chemicals and infrastructure expansion plans.  - Planned 1,400+ water distribution projects, worth nearly SAR 124 Bn and SAR 11 Bn worth of investments in wastewater reuse expected from National Water Company (2021 – 26).  - 3500+ km of additional water transmission lines expected to be added by The Water Transmission and Technologies Company.  - Projects such as NEOM, the Red Sea Project, Qiddiya Entertainment City, King Abdullah Financial District and Amaala to create significant demand.  - Periodic replacement of pump seals, bearings, seal housings and shaft sleeves in existing projects across relevant industries constitutes a demand driver.

source_rows.title: Sodium Cyanide

raw.title: Sodium Cyanide

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to develop local capabilities for sodium cyanide.

- Potential to collaborate with local industries and waste management facilities to utilize byproducts, creating a circular economy model that minimizes waste and maximizes resource utilization.

- Application: Sodium cyanide, a chemical compound renowned for its role in the mining sector, is indispensable for gold extraction processes. Its ability to form stable complexes with gold allows for efficient separation from ore, enabling extraction methods like cyanidation. 

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals - Sodium Cyanide (Assay solid with 98% purity in cubic form).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Increases in mining activity would create increased demand for sodium cyanide.
• Resource synergy – Saudi Arabia has abundant petrochemical resources, helping to create a secure and local supply chain for key raw materials required for sodium cyanide production, creating cost-efficiencies and reliability
• Proportional increases in demand with expansion of the mining industry / sector.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

source_rows.title: Pitch

raw.title: Pitch

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to invest in capability within Saudi Arabia to counter the strong foreign supply to Saudi Arabia.

- Application: Pitch is used in electrode production in the aluminum  industry.

- Products / Services Targeted: Liquid pitch manufacturing facility.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Resource availability – abundant access to petroleum resources, a primary source for producing liquid pitch. Leveraging local resources ensures a stable supply chain and has cost advantages.
• Potential to position liquid pitch manufacturing facility strategically to supply neighboring countries in the Gulf region. Saudi Arabia's geographical proximity and connectivity enhances export potential.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Global liquid pitch market estimated at SAR 13.1B in 2020, expected to reach SAR 19.1B by 2027 registering a CAGR of 5.4%. - Demand for pitch is driven by end use industries such as aluminum and Steel, both of which are growing in Saudi Arabia.

source_rows.title: MAKKAH HEALTHCARE WASTE TREATMENT CENTER

raw.title: MAKKAH HEALTHCARE WASTE TREATMENT CENTER
raw.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Makkah Cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has increased 
to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue of 
USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a CAGR of 
6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of reusable 
surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical 
waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection and 
transfer operators in Makkah cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Makkah are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in 
the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 19M USD*

Plant capacity: 55,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.77 years

GDP Impact: 100M USD

Location (Region): Makkah Cluster

Makkah’s population is expected to continue to grow over the 
next few decades, which can potentially generate significant 
demand for the project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste treatment 
infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance while also 
offering attractive returns to potential investors

source_rows.title: Fluoride

raw.title: Fluoride

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to build on Ma’aden’s high level of imports and establish a manufacturing plant for aluminum fluoride in Saudi Arabia.

- Application: Fluoride is a highly reactive and corrosive chemical element that is used in the mining industry for various purposes. This is primarily used in the production of aluminum.

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals (Fluoride).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Aluminum smelting capacity expected to increase in short-medium term, creating further demand.
• Demand for aluminum fluoride mainly dependent on production of aluminum metal and therefore driven by increase in downstream production of aluminum.
• Easy access to local customer base (Ma’aden has significant demand for aluminum fluoride and is currently fully dependent on imports).

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - In 2018, Saudi Arabia imported 9KT of aluminum fluoride, representing 100% of its local demand.

source_rows.title: Manufacturing Of Mechanical Seals For Industrial Equipment

raw.title: Manufacturing Of Mechanical Seals For Industrial Equipment
raw.description: This opportunity entails developing the value chain for the production of mechanical seals for industrial equipment to serve KSA and the broader GCC region.Overall demand for mechanical seals in Saudi Arabia has been growing, estimated to be 19,000 units in 2017. Driven by upcoming energy projects by Saudi Aramco, SEC and SWCC, demand is forecasted to increase at an annual growth rate of 6.1% to reach 30,300 units by 2025. Currently, KSA demand for mechanical seals for industrial equipment is addressed mainly domestically; however, the remaining 30% is addressed through imports, presenting a great opportunity for investors to localize production.Beyond the KSA market, investors in Saudi have the opportunity to tap into the larger regional market in the GCC. With a growing demand in the region for high-quality mechanical seals used in oil and gas, water and wastewater, and power projects, the demand in the rest of the GCC is expected to increase from 29,000 units in 2017 to 45,000 units by 2025.In addition to an increasing market demand, Saudi Arabia has competitive costs for materials, labor and logistics and offers funding and incentives to investors.The main focus of this opportunity is to establish a manufacturing facility for mechanical seals for industrial equipment.Manufacturing: establish mechanical seals manufacturing facility to fabricate seals components, the facility to include turning, boring, grooving, milling, drilling and tapping capabilitiesFinishing operations: establish workshops to deliver hard facing, grinding, lapping, polishing and welding capabilities in addition to advanced surface treatment proceduresHowever, additional opportunities for localization exist across the value chain of mechanical seals production. These opportunities include:Design: establish a design and engineering capabilitiesInput materials: establish local foundriesInstallation and maintenance: offer support services, including quality control, assembly, and installation servicesInstallation and maintenance: offer maintenance services and repair services for mechanical seals and installed base

source_rows.title: Manufacturing Of Industrial Gears

raw.title: Manufacturing Of Industrial Gears
raw.description: This opportunity entails developing the value chain for the production of gears for industrial machinery to serve KSA and the broader GCC region.The overall demand for industrial gears in Saudi Arabia has been growing, estimated at USD 97 million in 2017. Driven by the presence of several oil and gas manufacturing companies in the Kingdom, market size is forecasted to increase at an annual growth rate of 3% to reach USD 121 million by 2025. The global gears market is dominated by spur gears and bevel gears, having 50-80% market share.Beyond the KSA market, investors in Saudi have the opportunity to tap into the wider regional market of the GCC. With many companies in the GCC establishing extraction and production plants, demand for gears in the region has been increasing and is expected to continue to increase from USD 106 million in 2017 to USD 151 million by 2025.The main focus of this opportunity is to establish a manufacturing facility for industrial gears.Manufacturing: establish outsourced services offering heat treatment, machining…Manufacturing: establish facilities to produce locally and supply manufacturing facilitiesHowever, additional opportunities for localization exist across the value chain of industrial gears production. These opportunities include:Design: potential to be part of a larger design center setup by the EPC or the OEMRaw materials: localize production of key materials such as PEEK, Delrin, brass, etc.Operations and maintenance: offer support services, including maintenance, installation and operation services

raw.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Hafar Al Batin cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has increased to 2.6 
M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue of USD 
12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a CAGR of 6.9% during 
the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of reusable 
surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical waste 
management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided from 
public and private healthcare providers and transported to the 
facilities through waste collection and transfer operators in 
Hafar Al Batin Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Hafar Al Batin are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in the 
future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers 
for formulation of the opportunity

reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline in 2022, with

value chain

digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) are 
increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions

solutions in KSA

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic drop, 
reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline in 2022, with 
a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles from 
producers for processing and transfer along the further waste treatment 
value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) are 
increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by 
the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and sustainable 
solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life vehicle 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste management 
sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project can expect high level of 
engagement from the relevant authorities

Expected Investment size: 5MUSD*

market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected

total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The main input to the operation comes from the 
Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Asir's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition 
waste generation


government incentives for homeownership

source_rows.title: Pure nicotine

raw.title: Pure nicotine

details.description:
Badael is a pioneer in enhancing the quality of life through innovative and sustainable solutions. Committed to Saudi Vision 2030, Badael is dedicated to helping one million Saudis quit smoking by 2028.

To support this mission, Badael has launched its flagship product, DZRT, nicotine pouches that offer a less harmful, tobacco-free alternative to help individuals quit smoking.

An opportunity exists to establish a local manufacturing facility for pure nicotine, which would supply both Badael and global markets.

Application
Pure nicotine serves as the core active ingredient in nicotine pouches, delivering a controlled nicotine dose to satisfy cravings without the harmful chemicals found in traditional tobacco products.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Enhanced focus on Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Tobacco Control Strategy, aimed at improving the quality of life by promoting a smoke-free environment.
• Gain access to the largest market in the Middle East, with a rapidly growing population projected to reach 39.7 million by 2030.
• Limited local supply and the potential to export to regional markets.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The global nicotine pouch market is valued at $3.95 billion and is expected to reach $22.95 billion, registering a CAGR of 34.4%. - In Saudi Arabia, the market is currently valued at SAR 900 million and is expected to grow at a CAGR of 30%.

source_rows.title: Manufacturing Of Circuit Breakers

raw.title: Manufacturing Of Circuit Breakers
raw.description: This opportunity entails developing the value chain for the production of circuit breakers to serve KSA and the broader GCC region.The overall demand for circuit breakers in Saudi Arabia has been growing, estimated at USD 370 million in 2018. Driven by utilities, oil and gas and other manufacturing industries, KSA demand is forecasted to increase at an annual growth rate of 4% to reach USD 439 million by 2022. In 2018, demand for circuit breakers is 60% for high voltage and 30% for low voltage and ~10% for medium voltage. The split is expected to remain relatively the same till 2022.Beyond the KSA market, investors in Saudi have the opportunity to tap into the large regional market in the GCC with expected increase in demand from USD 308 million in 2018 to USD 370 million by 2022.The focus of this opportunity is on final manufacturing and components manufacturing of circuit breakers. These opportunities entail:Components manufacturing: establish manufacturing facilities conductors, contacts, operating mechanism and enclosuresFinal manufacturing and testing: establish facilities for final manufacturing of low circuit breakersFinal manufacturing and testing: establish facilities for final manufacturing of medium voltage circuit breakersFinal manufacturing and testing: establish world scale testing facilities for (e.g., vacuum interrupter predictive testing)However, there are additional opportunities across the circuit breakers manufacturing value chain. Opportunities include:Design: custom design and engineer circuit breakers for low and medium voltage applications for Saudi customersInput materials: manufacture copper alloys to meet KSA's specifications

Driven by utilities, oil and gas and other manufacturing industries, KSA demand is forecasted to increase at an annual growth rate of 4% to reach USD 439 million by 2022. In 2018, demand for circuit breakers is 60% for high voltage and 30% for low voltage and ~10% for medium voltage. The split is expected to remain relatively the same till 2022.Beyond the KSA market, investors in Saudi have the opportunity to tap into the large regional market in the GCC with expected increase in demand from USD 308 million in 2018 to USD 370 million by 2022.The focus of this opportunity is on final manufacturing and components manufacturing of circuit breakers. These opportunities entail:Components manufacturing: establish manufacturing facilities conductors, contacts, operating mechanism and enclosuresFinal manufacturing and testing: establish facilities for final manufacturing of low circuit breakersFinal manufacturing and testing: establish facilities for final manufacturing of medium voltage circuit breakersFinal manufacturing and testing: establish world scale testing facilities for (e.g., vacuum interrupter predictive testing)However, there are additional opportunities across the circuit breakers manufacturing value chain. Opportunities include:Design: custom design and engineer circuit breakers for low and medium voltage applications for Saudi customersInput materials: manufacture copper alloys to meet KSA's specifications

raw.title: Up-Scale Hotel Towers and Premium Commercial (Office) Towers – Dar Al Hijrah

details.description:
Description of Investment Opportunity
Rua Al Madinah Holding, a PIF company, is a key driver in developing infrastructure and assets that enhance Madinah’s position as a premier destination with a contemporary architectural landscape.

As part of this mandate, Rua Al Madinah Holding is offering investment opportunities in three upscale hotel towers and four upscale commercial towers, located within the Dar Al Hijrah project, a landmark mixed-use urban development in the holy city of Madinah, Saudi Arabia.

 

Deal Structure

Flexible deal structures are available, with multiple partnership models such as joint ventures, real estate funds, investment consortia and land or building leases

Assets Under Consideration

Hotel Towers (Shell & Core)

Opportunity 1: ~380 keys, BUA +40,300 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Opportunity 2: ~380 keys, BUA +40,300 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Opportunity 3: ~614 keys, BUA ≈70,000 sqm, 2 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Commercial (Office) Towers (Shell & Core)

Opportunity 4: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +10,650 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 5: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +9,500 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 6: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +13,380 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 7: BUA +56,300 sqm, land +8,850 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 16 floors
Investor Participation

Investors may participate in one or more of these opportunities

source_rows.title: Assembly of Aviation Oil Lubricant Manufacturer

raw.title: Assembly of Aviation Oil Lubricant Manufacturer

details.description:
Develop a Saudi-based aviation lubricant production facility to reduce reliance on imports.

 Partner with APSCO, ExxonMobil, and Aramco/Luberef to leverage global expertise and local manufacturing capabilities.

 Target a guaranteed domestic market (airlines, MROs, military aviation) and explore export opportunities in GCC & MENA.

 Enhance Saudi Arabia’s supply chain resilience by ensuring a stable, cost-effective lubricant supply.

Support Vision 2030 localization goals by reducing financial leakage and creating local jobs.

This Opportunity reduces financial leakage, enhances supply chain security, and creates a new industrial sector in Saudi Arabia. By localizing aviation lubricant production, this project can drive economic growth, reduce costs for airlines, and position Saudi Arabia as a regional hub for aviation lubricants.
Vision 2030 and the National Aviation Strategy set an ambitious target for the sector to grow from 100 Mn pax in 2019 to 330 Mn pax by 2030

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Currently there are no local assembly Aviation lubricant relying on international imports from one sources ( Exxon Mobile Texas plant)
• RTGs; potential to replace KSA imports

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: Cost Efficiency – Reduce import costs, shipping fees, and foreign currency risks. Operational Security – Ensure uninterrupted lubricant availability for commercial & military aviation. Economic Impact – Create local jobs, develop industrial expertise, and drive investment. Supply Chain Optimization – Eliminate logistics bottlenecks & price volatility. Sustainability & ESG Alignment – Support green aviation initiatives with localized, optimized production. KSA aviation sector to grow from 100Mn pax in 2019 to 330 Mn pax by 2030 KSA airlines’ fleet to grow from 250 aircrafts to 500 aircrafts Substantial regional demand from a strong aviation sector  Active players (non-exhaustive): International players: Exxon Mobile, Local Players: Apsco – Lubref/Aramco

source_rows.title: Adventure And Water Sport Activity Supplyer

raw.title: Adventure And Water Sport Activity Supplyer

details.description:
OPDC is seeking private sector investment and operational expertise to either JV or develop and manage a comprehensive range of water sports activities at THE RIG Project, a flagship tourism destination in Saudi Arabia. This opportunity allows private operators to provide services and equipment for various water sports while partnering with OPDC under a rent plus profit-sharing model. 

Products/services covered
- The opportunity targets a wide range of water sports and related services, including but not limited to:
- Adventure Water Sports: Kite surfing, surfing, jet skiing, e-foil rides, and motorized water sports.
- Recreational Water Sports: Diving, parasailing, snorkeling, and stand-up paddle boarding.
- Training Services: Professional lessons and certification for water sports enthusiasts.
- Rental Services: Equipment rentals for guests interested in independent water sport activities.
 
Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Upstream
- Investment in equipment and materials for water sports (e.g., jet skis, diving equipment, kite-boards).
- Recruitment and training of skilled personnel for operations and guest safety.
- Setting up operational hubs and storage facilities at “THE RIG”.

Midstream
- Service delivery, including providing water sports experiences, training, and rentals.
- Integration with “THE RIG’s” broader tourism offerings to enhance guest experiences.
- Adherence to OPDC’s standards for sustainability and safety.

Focus Area
- The opportunity is focused on offering a world-class, diverse water sports experience that complements the luxury tourism offerings at "THE RIG"

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• A unique opportunity to partner with a global tourism icon, a luxury, adventure-focused environment and become a vital part of the region's tourism evolution.
• OPDC is offering a lucrative rent plus profit-sharing model, enabling private sector players to generate consistent revenue without the need for significant upfront infrastructure investment.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia Adventure Tourism Market: Growing at 8-12% YoY. - GCC Water Sports Market: Growing at 6-8% YoY.  Mega Projects Boom – Government support tourism - High Demand for Experiences - Tourists are shifting towards unique, adrenaline-filled activities, creating demand for water sports such as kite surfing, e-foil, parasailing, and diving.

source_rows.title: Labor Accommodation - Rua Al Haram

raw.title: Labor Accommodation - Rua Al Haram

details.description:
The Rua Al Haram development project presents a strategic investment opportunity for private investors to participate in the design, construction, and operation of logistics and labor accommodation facilities critical to the success of this large-scale, multi-phase development. These facilities will play a pivotal role in supporting the project's construction and operational activities, addressing workforce housing, material handling, and overall construction logistics.

Based on the current forecast (subject to change) of daily labor personnel numbers, the labor accommodation would have the following key characteristics:

- Land  – The land required is based upon 3-story residential buildings = 300m.sq x 600m.sq = 180,000 m.sq land area.
- Capacity required – The employee residential facilities would be required for ~ 5,000 employees consisting of:
      - 1 Bedroom (40 sq. m per room) – 8
      - 1 Bedroom (20m.sq per room) – 112
      - 2 Bed per room (20m.sq per room) – 280
      - 4 beds per room (24m.sq per room) – 1080

- Additional facilities include kitchens, dining, recreation, sport, laundry, admin, security, medical, retail, fire station, swimming pools, parking, and utilities. Additionally, other facilities, such as - compounds for contractors, consultants' offices, warehouses, off-site manufacturing, etc. (typically requiring ∼1,500 m.sq. for 200 people.

This opportunity targets essential infrastructure and operational services, including worker housing, transportation, material storage, batching plants, construction logistics, and security systems. These offerings are critical to supporting the smooth execution of the Rua Al Haram project and ensuring its timely delivery. They also create long-term value for investors through sustained demand and operational scalability.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• This opportunity offers strategic alignment with national priorities, financially lucrative revenue streams, and the chance to play a central role in one of the region's most significant urban development projects. By addressing critical project needs for logistics and labor accommodations, investors can secure a high-impact, low-risk position in a transformative initiative with long-term growth potential.
• The strategic benefits of this opportunity are rooted in the scale and complexity of the Rua Al Haram project, regional development priorities under Vision 2030, and technological and operational advancements that enhance efficiency and scalability. These benefits ensure sustained demand, long-term profitability, and expansion opportunities.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Rua Al Haram represents the region's unparalleled urban development initiative, setting a new benchmark for scale and ambition. Its portfolio comprises of hotel guest rooms, residential units, commercial space, and prayer areas. - The project is expected to require a workforce of significant scale, reaching over 100,000 workers at peak construction.

source_rows.title: Pumped Hydro Storage (PHS) N1 at NEOM

raw.title: Pumped Hydro Storage (PHS) N1 at NEOM

details.description:
Description of Investment Opportunity
NEOM aims to become the world’s first 100% renewable electricity system with energy generation based mainly on solar. Energy storage is required to store excess solar energy during the day and release it at night. Pumped Hydro Storage (PHS) is the most mature and cost competitive storage available. Waterways and powerhouse to be located completely underground to improve land conservation, durability and aesthetics.

 

Deal Structure:
The project is envisioned to be structured as a Build–Own–Operate–Transfer (“BOOT”) in accordance with best industry practices
Time schedule assumes commercial and financial close in Q3 2025 and first energy in Q4 2029

Technical Considerations: 
- Installed capacity  – 2.2 GW
- Generation max power – 2.1 GW
- Storage capacity – 23.1 GWh
- Time constant in turbine mode – 11 hours
- Round trip efficiency – 80%

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• PHS shall become an iconic piece of energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia
• Robust contractual structure in line with best international practices
• Stable and predictable cash-flows, credit support and risk allocation will ensure bankability of the project

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - NEOM aims to create the world’s first 100% renewable energy system, underpinning demand for long-term energy storage. PHS will be the first of several PHS facilities at NEOM

source_rows.title: Jeddah Central Development Company Oceanarium

raw.title: Jeddah Central Development Company Oceanarium

details.description:
Jeddah Central Development Company is seeking a qualified private sector investor interested in partnering to finance the Oceanarium. The company is exploring different private sector participants.

A world-class oceanarium and coral farm, as well as a maritime research hub, situated along the coastal area of Jeddah. Designed by SOM from the United States the facility will feature seven pavilions (Shoreline and Mangrove, Coral Reef, The Vortex, Depth of the Red Sea, Back to the Shore, Restoration & Production of a Reef, and Technology & Products from the Red Sea) aimed at enhancing visitors' experience. The total land area is 43,924 m2, total Gross Floor Area (GFA) is nearly 21,076 m2, with an average capacity of 2,500 persons. 

The Oceanarium is situated at the Jeddah Center destination project, the heart of Jeddah, Saudi Arabia’s second-largest city, and gateway to Mekkah. Spanning an impressive 5.7 million m2, with 9.5 km of coastline. Jeddah Central is set to become a global waterfront destination with extensive mixed-use assets, including hospitality, retail, commercial, and residential properties, and key landmarks. The project is positioned as a leading tourist destination, aiming to preserve Jeddah’s rich culture while revitalizing the downtown area.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Investing in an income-generating asset under a PPP structure.
• Playing a part in financing an environment-friendly—including promoting biodiversity—a social asset with a positive social and environmental impact.
• Diversifying the investment portfolio.
• Fostering trust and collaboration with a leading PIF-owned portfolio company.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: Admission revenue, event space for corporates in coffee and gift shops, superb restaurants, VIP suites, rentals in glass-bottom kayaks, rentals in upcharge experiences (including tours, animal interactions, and sea trek helmet diving), and sponsorships are the seven largest revenue drivers, accounting for over 90% of total revenue.

source_rows.title: Ceramic Sanitary Ware Manufacturing

raw.title: Ceramic Sanitary Ware Manufacturing

details.description:
Establishing one or more ceramic sanitary ware manufacturing plants to address the local supply gap of 13-17M units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Production of mid-range and premium sanitary ware products across a wide product range (water closets, wash basins, bathtubs) 
- Full automation of production lines to ensure high-quality finishing

cardsData.stat:
SAR 250-300M (USD 66.7-80M)
[For a facility of 2.5M units per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to replace imported premium, super-premium, and mid-range sanitary ware products
• Local availability of key raw materials (kaolin, ball clay, feldspar, and silica, as well as gypsum and resin used for making the molds)
• Cost competitiveness of local production due to lower logistics cost and avoidance of 12% import tariffs
• Current Market
• Mid-range and premium segments together make up ~60% of the market
• Local players Saudi Ceramics, Al Forsan, Porsalina, Casa Via cater to basic and a small part of mid-range segment
• Global brands such as Kohler (USA), Roca (Spain), Geberit (Switzerland), RAK Ceramics (UAE) serve mid-range and entire premium segment
• Local suppliers of input materials
• Imerys (kaolin, ball clay), Gulf Sands (silica), Saudi Ceramics (feldspar)

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative demand of ~380M units of ceramic sanitary ware in Saudi Arabia for the 2025-2040 period; mid-range and premium segments’ market share to grow, at the expense of the basic segment - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

source_rows.title: Excavators and Loaders Spares Manufacturing

raw.title: Excavators and Loaders Spares Manufacturing

details.description:
Establishing one or more facilities to manufacture spare components of excavators and loaders (buckets, accessories, cylinders, radiators, hydraulic hoses, track pads, and adjusters) to address the local supply gap of 300,000-390,000 tons per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Focus on catering to the spare parts market for post-warranty units (average post-warranty fleet size is ~48,000 units from 2023 to 2030)
- Future expansion potential to spares of other steel-based components (e.g., book, arm)

cardsData.stat:
SAR 20-25M (USD 5.3-6.7M)
[For a facility of 25,000 - 30,000 tons capacity, excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Growing demand for third-party spares as OEM manufactured spare parts are priced 20-30% higher and often have long lead time of one-to-three months
• Local availability of raw materials (steel)
• Cost advantage over imported spares, which attract a tariff of 10-15%
• Limited manufacturers of components for excavators and loaders in the GCC; proximity to the markets with better pricing and lead times than those of OEMs will enhance competitiveness
• Current Market
• New equipment come with a one-to-two-year warranty during which OEM dealers offer servicing with OEM spare parts
• Post warranty customers are open to using third-party spares, primarily due to cost competitiveness
• Currently, the OEM dealers supply spares to the majority of the market even post warranty due to limited availability of locally manufactured third-party spares

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative demand of ~SAR 38B for spares of buckets, accessories, cylinders, radiators, hydraulic hoses, track pads, and adjusters in Saudi Arabia for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

source_rows.title: Mobility Operator Land/Offshore

raw.title: Mobility Operator Land/Offshore

details.description:
OPDC's THE RIG. project offers an opportunity for the private sector to propose innovative and sustainable mass mobility solutions for transporting visitors from onshore terminals to THE RIG. destination. This project spans 30 years, with the possibility of the operating model being based on a long-term lease or an operational management model.

The focus is on offering safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions, including options such as electric, hybrid, and cutting-edge technologies like sea gliders or hovercraft.

Products/services covered
The primary services targeted by this opportunity are transportation and mobility solutions for visitors. The focus is on providing a mass transit system that ensures safe, efficient, and comfortable transportation between onshore terminals and offshore on THE RIG. destination. The products or services could include
 - Electric or hybrid-powered transport options.
- Innovative transportation technologies (e.g., sea gliders, hovercraft).
- Long-term operational leasing or management services.
- Maintenance and safety assurance services for transportation solutions.
 
Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Design and Development
- The development and design of transportation solutions (e.g., electric/hybrid vehicles, sea gliders, hovercraft).

Manufacturing
- The production of transportation solutions, including any customization needed for offshore travel.

Operations
- Managing the transportation of visitors on a daily basis, including crew operations, maintenance, and safety management.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Tourism Development
• The project enhances the tourism sector, contributing to KSA’s ambition to become a leading global tourist destination. THE RIG project will likely attract significant numbers of international visitors, making efficient mass mobility solutions essential.
• Technological Leadership
• The opportunity allows for the integration of cutting-edge mobility technologies such as sea gliders and hovercraft, reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position as a leader in innovative and advanced transport systems.
• Long-Term Revenue Generation
• With a 30-year span and the potential for long-term leases or operation models, the project offers significant financial returns, making it an attractive investment for the private sector.

source_rows.title: Accommodation Facilities at the RIG

raw.title: Accommodation Facilities at the RIG

details.description:
Oil Park Development Company (OPDC) is seeking private sector participation to develop or provide accommodation for 2,300 employees working in the tourism and hotel sector at THE RIG.

This opportunity invites private investors to either construct new accommodation facilities tailored to the project’s needs, or propose existing assets that can be repurposed or adapted for this purpose.

Products/services covered
- Long-term workforce accommodation solutions (housing, utilities, and amenities).
- Hospitality services, including catering and housekeeping for employees.

Secondary Services
- Facility management (maintenance, operations, and security) and transportation services to and from THE RIG. site.

Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Upstream
- Design and development of accommodation facilities (construction or retrofitting existing buildings).
- Securing private investment or joint venture partnerships with OPDC.

Midstream
- Construction or adaptation of assets to meet OPDC’s specifications for employee accommodation.
- Development of infrastructure to provide utilities, transportation, and connectivity.

Downstream
- Day-to-day operation and management of the accommodation facilities.
- Providing services such as catering, cleaning, maintenance, and security.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The hospitality and tourism workforce in Saudi Arabia is growing at a rate of 7-10% YoY. - The broader GCC hospitality market is growing at 4-6% YoY. - The hospitality sector in Saudi Arabia is expected to boom due to giga-projects and government support of tourism.

SIRC subsidiary AKAM seeks a joint venture partner to establish, operate, and manage a state-of-the-art Construction and Demolition Waste (CDW) recycling facility in Saudi Arabia. - Development, installation, and commissioning of power generation and distribution infrastructure.

Downstream

details.description:
- Description An opportunity exists to develop local capabilities for recycling Aluminum scrap.

The process involves simply re-melting the metal, which is far less expensive and energy intensive than producing new aluminum  from Bauxite Ore.

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals - aluminum  7602 Scrap – Mixed, Ext, Coated (UBC), 1st Quality.

• Quality: Concerns around the quality of aluminum scrap – Ma’aden requires aluminum 7602 Scrap – Mixed, Ext, Coated (UBC), 1st Quality.

source_rows.title: Petroleum Coke

raw.title: Petroleum Coke

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to establish local manufacturing facility with a capacity of 250 ktpa for petroleum coke.

- Application: Petroleum coke is a carbon-rich solid material that is produced during oil refining. In its raw form it is known as Green Petroleum Coke (GPC). It is used for carbon anode manufacturing in aluminum smelters

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals (Petroleum Coke).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC) offers good potential with favorable logistics to export to rest of the leading MENA aluminum smelters and steel plants – very large amount of foreign spend to be localized.
• Saudi Arabia has proximity to raw material (Green Petroleum Coke) sources, including UAE and Oman – increasing investment opportunity.
• Ma’aden have agreed a major deal signed from 2025 onwards to purchase Pet Coke locally from new facility in Saudi Arabia. Despite this agreement, there is still significant opportunity to build on local capability within Saudi Arabia.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - First mover advantages due to lack of established capacity in Saudi Arabia. - Ma’aden Aluminum would be the primary buyer within Saudi Arabia. - Saudi Arabia’s geographical advantage and trade agreements with neighboring countries make exporting favorable.

raw.title: Post-Processing Services for Manufacturing

details.description:
National Additive Manufacturing & Innovation Company (NAMI), a joint venture between 3D Systems Corporation and Dussur, specializes in first of its kind innovation and 3D printing center.

The opportunity lies in providing a range of post-processing services to enhance the quality, functionality, and performance of manufactured products in Saudi Arabia.

Products/Services covered

Surface finishing
- Sanding, polishing, sand blasting, shot peening, chemical milling, tumbling, electropolishing, abrasive flow machining, painting

Heat treatment
- Stress relief, aging, solution annealing (vacuum HT) for Steels, Ni-alloys, Titanium, Al-alloys

Cleaning
- Ultrasonic cleaning, chemical cleaning, advanced de-powdering

Inspection and quality control
- Dimensional inspection (CMM, optical), non-destructive testing (X-Ray, FPI, DPI), powder flowability & PSD

Assembly and integration
- Final assembly of components, coatings

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Improved product quality and performance
• Reduced manufacturing costs in comparison with outsourcing abroad
• Supporting local manufacturing growth
• Opening new markets for customer looking only for finished components

source_rows.title: Magnesium

raw.title: Magnesium

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to invest in expanding the local supply of Magnesium by establishing plant with a capacity of 30 ktpa.

- Magnesium is mainly used in aluminum  alloys (34% of global demand), magnesium die-castings (32% of global demand) and titanium sponge production (15% of demand). Other end-uses include steel desulphurization, iron casting and cathodic protection.

- Application: Magnesium is a lightweight, silvery-white metal that is commonly used in the mining industry. Magnesium oxide (MgO) is produced by the calcination of magnesium carbonate.

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals (Magnesium).

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Increasing demand is driven by the growth of the automotive industry and their need for magnesium die casting.
• Saudi Arabia and global market is projected to continue to grow until the year 2030 and beyond (extreme CAGR of 10.8%).

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia has abundant dolomite resources which could be used as feedstock for the magnesium metal plant.

source_rows.title: Construction / Staff Village Development T1

raw.title: Construction / Staff Village Development T1

details.description:
Deal Structure:
The Project presents an investment opportunity for the private sector to enter into a development agreement to design, build, finance, operate, insure, and maintain a Construction and Staff Village The transaction will be structured as a 32-year deal, with an upfront investment of ~SAR 2-3B required from the private sector for construction

Assets Under Consideration:
- The project will involve development of a ~12,300-bed Construction Village to meet the short-term demand for 2 years in 2024-2026
- The development will then be converted, over a 3-month rolling refurbishment period, to a permanent ~8,500-bed Staff Village to meet the long-term staff accommodation demand for 30 years
- The project will accommodate a portion of the staff expected to be employed

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Captive and exclusive tenant market: hotels / hospitality businesses will use these staff villages on an exclusive basis, therefore de-risking the investment
• Consistent cash flow generation during the construction phase: the construction village will be used by captive contractors’ staff ensuring high utilization and cash flow generation
• NEOM commitment: significant developments are already underway
• Capital efficient investment: opportunity to invest into a unique product with low refurbishment costs to convert into Staff Village, and generating long term cashflows

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Access to NEOM : Opportunity to become a key development and investment partner in developing NEOM, and access subsequent investment opportunities across NEOM - Promising tourism demand: Demand for hotel assets is expected to be very high, as NEOM is planned to be a key tourist attractor for the wider region with its unique offerings and year-round activities

Establish a local UTEX providing a comprehensive inventory of spare parts, increasing availability.

A UTEX allows a defective part in the rail sector to be replaced in a few days, while it gets repaired to new condition and goes into UTEX inventory.

cardsData.stat:
SAR 1-1.2B (USD 0.27-0.32B)
Projected for 2024-2030 across Saudi Arabia

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Saudi-based UTEX will be well-positioned to cater to the broader GCC rolling stock spares market.
• Export potential of SAR 100 – 150 M annually.
• Opportunity to replace imports of new spare parts to Saudi Arabia.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by 2.5x (to 13,000 km of track), increase passenger volume by 10x, and increase freight volumes by 8x by 2030, which results in increasing use for spare parts, and therefore increasing maintenance, repairs and operations spend. - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network).

source_rows.title: Gaskets and Seals

raw.title: Gaskets and Seals

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to meet Ma’aden’s demand through domestically manufactured products, Establish local manufacturing capability for Caskets & Steals.

- A gasket fills the space between two or more mating surfaces to prevent leakage from the joined objects while under compression. Category scope includes gaskets, bushing and their sub types.

- Ma’aden’s existing gasket demand is currently split between in country and foreign suppliers, opportunity exists to more fully meet Ma’aden’s demand through domestically manufactured products.
- Value chain: Gaskets can mainly be found Inside process equipment like pumps and compressors or outside process equipment like flanges.

- Application: Gaskets are mechanical components used in the mining industry to seal joints and prevent leaks. Seals are mechanical components used in the mining industry to prevent the leakage of fluids, gases, and other substances.  

- Products / Services Targeted: Gaskets, spiral wound, pre-cut, jacketed, ring joint, camprofile. seals, mechanical, Labyrinth.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point: • Middle East Gaskets & Seals Market expected to account for $6.87bn by 2028. This equates to a CAGR of 5% over the forecast period

details.description:
The aviation industry is undergoing a significant transformation, with airlines modernizing their fleets and retiring older aircraft at an accelerating pace.

This has created an opportunity to establish a state-of-the-art aircraft recycling hub dedicated to the aerospace industry with a melting capability to produce raw material and a recycled spare parts facility.

The facility would serve not only local but also regional airlines.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• There is a growing trend towards retiring older aircrafts due to up to 40% higher fuel consumption
• The opportunity also aligns with Saudi Green Initiative by promoting sustainable industrial practices, reducing waste, and cutting carbon emissions.

source_rows.title: uPVC Door and Window Systems Fabrication

raw.title: uPVC Door and Window Systems Fabrication

details.description:
Establishing one or more uPVC door and window systems fabrication plants to address the local supply gap of 1.4-2.0M units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of uPVC profiles, glass panes, and accessories to fabricate the final product 
- Automation of large-scale assembly lines to competitively fulfil large orders
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities to extrude uPVC profiles

cardsData.stat:
SAR 90-110M (USD 24-29.3M)
[For a facility of 100K units per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to substitute imports of uPVC doors and windows (~SAR 160M in 2022)
• Abundant availability of uPVC resin in Saudi Arabia from SABIC (through SAPPCO), a key local supplier of uPVC resin with production plants in Riyadh and Dammam
• Large production volumes allowing for automation, resulting in EBITDA margins of ~20% in line with global leaders

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Consolidated local market with three players holding ~60% share; rest addressed by small players and imports, mostly from China and Turkey
• Key local players
• Wintek SA and Fazah Group have capability to locally extrude uPVC profiles with European standards, and Creative Windows Co,, which importing uPVC profiles from Germany
• Local suppliers of input material: Wintek (extrusions), Fazah (extrusions), AGC Obeikan (glass), Uniglass (glass), and Guardian Glass (glass)

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative national demand 32M uPVC units for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

raw.title: Door Locks Production

details.description:
Establishing one or more door locks manufacturing plants to address the local supply gap of 6.3-8.2M locks per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Focus on production of locks for residential doors – both new doors and after sales/ replacement market; large upcoming local demand for residential doors (~98M units from 2025 to 2040)
- Inclusion of capability to produce the sub-components within the facility (e.g., cylinders, bolts, springs)

cardsData.stat:
SAR 30-60M (USD 8-16M)
[For a facility of 1-2M units per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to replace imports of door locks (~SAR 400M in 2022)
• Export potential to cater to a market demand of more thn SAR 600M (10-12M units) in GCC (excluding Saudi Arabia)
• Cost competitiveness of local production due to lower logistics cost and avoidance of 15% import tariffs
• Local procurement preference in contracts (e.g., price preference, local content consideration in commercial evaluation)

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Market supplied solely through imports, of which 47% comes from China, 36% from Europe (Italy 22%, Germany 7%, Spain 6%, Greece 2%), and 5% from the US
• International players

• Demand centers
• 50% of demand is driven by contractors requiring premium and medium-grade locks based on the project specification, and 50% from consumer after-sales market for medium-grade locks

source_rows.title: Wood Doors Fabrication

raw.title: Wood Doors Fabrication

details.description:
Establishing one or more wood doors fabrication plants to address the local supply gap of 3.5-5M doors per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Processing of wood to produce hollow-core and solid-core doors for residential projects
- Automation of assembly lines to competitively fulfill large orders
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities in after-sales repair and maintenance services

cardsData.stat:
SAR 100-150M (USD 26.7-40M)
[For a facility of 200K units per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Favorable competitive environment due to absence of local at-scale suppliers to fulfill large demand orders
• Potential for horizontal expansion to adjacent wood products (e.g., cumulative demand from 2025 to 2040 for wood cabinetry products from PIF projects > SAR 4B)
• Large production volumes allowing for automation, resulting in EBITDA margins higher than local competition, with estimated EBITDA margin of 9-14% for medium-sized players and less than 5% for small players

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Highly fragmented, consisting mostly of small to medium-sized players, with production inefficiencies(low capacity and higher cost per unit compared to doors produced in automated lines)
• Local players
• Alfa Wood, Bin Laden Wood Factory, MWP Co., Othman Wood (non-exhaustive)
• Local suppliers of input materials
• Major components (e.g., fiberboards, solid wood, accessories, and locks) are imported

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative national demand ~98M residential doors units (~SAR 147B) for the 2025-2040 period, with largest residential doors segment is wood, representing 75%-85% of existing doors - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

source_rows.title: Fleece

raw.title: Fleece

details.description:
Badael is a pioneer in enhancing the quality of life through innovative and sustainable solutions. Committed to Saudi Vision 2030, Badael is dedicated to helping one million Saudis quit smoking by 2028.

To support this mission, Badael has launched its flagship product, DZRT, nicotine pouches that offer a less harmful, tobacco-free alternative to help individuals quit smoking.

An opportunity exists to establish local manufacturing facility for fleece to supply to Badael as well as global markets.
 

Application
Fleece provides a soft, porous material that ensures even distribution and controlled release of nicotine, enhancing user comfort and product performance.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Enhanced focus on Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Tobacco Control Strategy, aimed at improving the quality of life by promoting a smoke-free environment.
• Gain access to the largest market in the Middle East, with a rapidly growing population projected to reach 39.7 million by 2030.
• Limited local supply and the potential to export to regional markets.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The global nicotine pouch market is valued at $3.95 billion and is expected to reach $22.95 billion, registering a CAGR of 34.4%. - In Saudi Arabia, the market is currently valued at SAR 900 million and is expected to grow at a CAGR of 30%.

details.description:
Badael is a pioneer in enhancing the quality of life through innovative and sustainable solutions. Committed to Saudi Vision 2030, Badael is dedicated to helping one million Saudis quit smoking by 2028.

To support this mission, Badael has launched its flagship product, DZRT, nicotine pouches that offer a less harmful, tobacco-free alternative to help individuals quit smoking.

An opportunity exists to establish local manufacturing facility for flavors to supply to Badael as well as global markets.

 

Application
Flavors play a vital role in nicotine pouches by enhancing the user experience with a variety of taste profiles, making the product more appealing and helping users transition away from traditional tobacco products.

source_rows.title: Polyether Monomer Manufacturing

raw.title: Polyether Monomer Manufacturing

details.description:
- Establishing one or more polyether monomer production plants to address the local supply gap of 9,000-12,000 tons per annum
- Focus on producing T-shaped isopentyl polyethylene glycol (TPEG) and methoxy polyethylene glycol (MPEG) monomers to cater to demand driven by PCE producers

cardsData.stat:
SAR 700-800M (USD 186.7-213.3M)
[For a facility of 45 ktpa capacity; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Absence of local production of polyether monomers
• Local availability of raw materials required for manufacturing polyether monomers (ethylene oxide, isobutylene, methanol, formaldehyde) at a significant cost advantage compared with global competitors
• Potential upside from demand from developing pharmaceutical industry in Saudi Arabia; globally, 80% of polyether monomer demand originates from the pharma industry
• Growing PCE use in other GCC countries will lead to additional demand of 16,000-24,000 tons of polyether monomers per annum; no polyether monomer producers present in other GCC countries
• Current Market
• Polyether monomers are synthesized by global chemicals companies such as Fengchen, BASF, Dow Chemical, Lotte Chemicals, and INEOS in locations including China, Europe, US, South Korea
• Local suppliers of input chemicals: Sadara, Saudi Kayan, Saudi Yanbu Petrochemical Company, Saudi European Petrochemical Company, Aramco

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative Saudi Arabia polyether monomer demand from concrete admixtures only of ~167,000 tons (~ SAR 1B) for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by the need for PCE-based concrete admixtures in PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

source_rows.title: Batch Plant Mixers Manufacturing

raw.title: Batch Plant Mixers Manufacturing

details.description:
Establishing one or more production facilities to manufacture batch mixers to address the local supply gap of 75-110 units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Processing of steel, alloy casting and plastic to produce mixer components
- Focus on supplying to the batch plants mixers replacement market
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities in after-sales repair and maintenance services

cardsData.stat:
SAR 50-60M (USD 13.3-16M)
[For a facility of 75-100K units per year; excluding land cost]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Absence of local production of batch plant mixers
• Local availability of raw materials required for manufacturing the mixer components (steel, alloy casting, and plastic)
• Large export potential to cater to a demand of ~300 units per annum (~SAR 150M) in GCC countries (excluding Saudi Arabia)

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Market supplied solely through imports, of which 70% comes from Europe, 20% from China
• Sicoma (Italy), Liebherr (Switzerland), BHS-Sonthofen (Germany)

source_rows.title: Lubricants

raw.title: Lubricants

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to address current market and take advantage of growing demand to establish strong local manufacturing capability.

- Market can be segmented by type into forged grinding media, high chrome cast grinding media, others, and can be segmented by application into chemistry industry, metallurgy industry, cement plant, power plant, others.

- Application: Lubricants are substances used in the mining industry to reduce friction between moving parts and prevent wear and tear.

- Products / Services Targeted: Oil, grease, penetrating lubricants and dry lubricants.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The global lubricants market size was valued at SAR 446.5 B in 2023 and is projected to be worth SAR 453.6B in 2024 and reach SAR 527.1B by 2032, exhibiting a CAGR of 2.3% during the forecast period. - Saudi Arabia lubricants market size is valued at SAR 5.2B in 2021, growing at a CAGR of 2.05% rate during the forecast period 2022 to 2028. - Highly consolidated market, with top 5 players accounting for more than 90% of the market.

source_rows.title: HAIL END OF LIFE VEHICLES TREATMENT FACILITY

raw.title: HAIL END OF LIFE VEHICLES TREATMENT FACILITY
raw.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Hail Cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic drop, 
reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline in 2022, with 
a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles from 
producers for processing and transfer along the further waste treatment 
value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) are 
increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by 
the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and sustainable 
solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life vehicle 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste management 
sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project can expect high level of 
engagement from the relevant authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 4MUSD*

Plant capacity: 19,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.90%

Payback period: 8.04 years

GDP Impact: 69M USD

Location (Region): Hail Cluster


Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic drop, 
reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline in 2022, with 
a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles from 
producers for processing and transfer along the further waste treatment 
value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming consumer 
behavior in the Kingdom (increasing digitization, 
increasing personal consumption etc.) are increasing 
vehicle consumption requiring uplift in waste treatment 
solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by the 
Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private sector 
participation require innovative, and sustainable 
solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life vehicle 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste management 
sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project can expect high level of 
engagement from the relevant authorities



raw.description:
The project aims to establish an inert landfill facility for construction and demolition waste in Yanbu.

The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected 
to reach $542.7 billion in 2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% of the 
total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The main input to the operation comes from the 
Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Yanbu's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation


incentives for homeownership

of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions

raw_data_json.title: YANBU INERT LANDFILL
raw_data_json.description:
The project aims to establish an inert landfill facility for construction and demolition waste in Yanbu.

The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected 
to reach $542.7 billion in 2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% of the 
total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The main input to the operation comes from the 
Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Yanbu's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions
* CAGR




Plant capacity: 295,291 tons

Expected IRR: 10.3%

Payback period: 6.54 years

GDP Impact: 29M USD


source_rows.title: Excavators and Loaders Assembly

raw.title: Excavators and Loaders Assembly

details.description:
Establishing one or more excavators and loaders assembly plants to address the local supply gap of 12,800-16,200 units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of excavator and loader units with Stage V diesel engines
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities in after-sales repair and maintenance services

cardsData.stat:
SAR 350-400M (USD 93.3-106.7M)
[For a facility of 1,500 units per year, excluding land]

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Export potential to the Middle Eastern and African market, given absence of assembly facilities in the region
• Advantage over other OEMs owing to customers’ preference for locally produced units for better demand responsiveness
• Opportunity to be an anchor investment in the heavy machinery production sector in one of the most promising and fastest-growing markets in the world

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Consolidated supply landscape with five global OEMs – Caterpillar (US), Komatsu (Japan), Hyundai-Doosan (South Korea), Volvo (Sweden), and XCMG (China) – holding 75-80% market share
• Each OEM has exclusive local dealerships in Saudi Arabia for sales, distribution, and product support
• Saudi Arabia currently has no assembly facility; the local dealers import fully built-up units
• China, South Korea, India, Japan, and the US account for more than 90% of the imports (by value)

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers
keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

source_rows.title: ZATCA, in collaboration with NCP, launch EOI for Water and Sewage Treatment Plants PPP Project at 10 Land Ports

raw.title: ZATCA, in collaboration with NCP, launch EOI for Water and Sewage Treatment Plants PPP Project at 10 Land Ports
raw.raw_text: News Return to Media Center 09/06/2024 Previous Next ZATCA, in collaboration with NCP, launch EOI for Water and Sewage Treatment Plants PPP Project at 10 Land Ports Page Image Riyadh, June 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) Page Content Riyadh, June 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for Water and Sewage Treatment Plants Project at Land Ports through a Public-Private-Partnership (PPP). The project will be tendered under a Design-Build-Finance-Operate-Maintain-Transfer (DBFOMT) model, with a contract duration of 15 years, including the construction period. The project will be implemented on ten land ports across the Kingdom. These include Al Batha, Salwa, Al Khafji, Al Raqi, Jadidat Arar, Al Hadithah, Halat Ammar, Al Durrah, Al Wadiah, and Empty Quarter. The project encompasses the design, construction, expansion, and refurbishment of plants and related assets, including networks. Additionally, it will include the supervision of the construction activities. In addition to the above, the project involves overseeing the daily operations of the plants and related assets, management of network operations, recording and reporting on operations, and ensuring alternative water and sewage treatment supply in case of interruption. Furthermore, it includes the performance of preventive maintenance for plants, networks, and related assets, cleaning of civil structures and plants, provision of spare parts and replacements, recording and reporting of maintenance, execution of lifecycle replacements and repairs, and monitoring of maintenance activities. ZATCA and NCP invite local and international investors interested in the project to visit the NCP website and review the EOI document. All interested companies should submit their EOI by 30, June 2024 at 3:00 pm KSA time. ​ Share | Print

raw.title: ZATCA and NCP Launch RFQ for Power Plant PPP Project at Empty Quarter (Rub
raw.raw_text: News Return to Media Center 11/06/2024 Previous Next ZATCA and NCP Launch RFQ for Power Plant PPP Project at Empty Quarter (Rub'al Khali) Land Port Page Image Zakat, Tax, and Customs Authority (ZATCA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), launched the Request for Qualification (RFQ) Page Content Zakat, Tax, and Customs Authority (ZATCA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), launched the Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for the development of a hybrid power plant at the Empty Quarter land port (Rub'al Khali). The project aims to reduce the use of diesel fuel by using renewable energy and ensure long term power supply at the Empty Quarter land port through a Public-Private-Partnership (PPP) in line with the Kingdom's Vision 2030. ZATCA stated that the project will be implemented in partnership with the private sector, under a Design-Build-Finance-Operate-Maintain-Transfer (DBFOMT) contract model for a term of 25 years in addition to the construction period. The project involves designing, developing, operating, and maintaining a power generation facility at the Empty Quarter land port to meet ZATCA's electricity demand and technical specifications. This includes ensuring that the facility operates in accordance with the defined requirements and output specifications, as well as managing power generation and connection to the ZATCA interface point for the specified term of the project. Interested parties can request the RFQ document, by submitting the request form via NCP's website, www.ncp.gov.sa. Furthermore, the submission phase for the RFQ will remain open until July 21, 2024 at 3:00pm KSA time. Share | Print

source_rows.title: ZATCA and NCP Launch EOI and RFQ for Development and Operations of Customs Warehouses Project at 38 Points of Entry

raw.title: ZATCA and NCP Launch EOI and RFQ for Development and Operations of Customs Warehouses Project at 38 Points of Entry
raw.raw_text: News Return to Media Center 06/10/2024 Previous Next ZATCA and NCP Launch EOI and RFQ for Development and Operations of Customs Warehouses Project at 38 Points of Entry Page Image Riyadh, October 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), Page Content Riyadh, October 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for Development and Operations of Customs Warehouses Project at 38 Points of Entry (PoEs) across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The project will be tendered under a Design-Build-Finance-Maintain-Operate-Transfer (DBFMOT) model, with a contract duration of 15 years, including the construction period. The project involves the design, construction and maintenance of 13 warehouses: 12 new facilities and renovation of one existing warehouse. Operational responsibilities will cover all new and existing warehouses across 38 PoEs. This will include loading and off-loading goods in the warehouses, operating forklifts, cranes, and trucks, as well as providing cleaning services. Additionally, the project encompasses the provision of new equipment for all 38 warehouses. ZATCA and NCP invite local and international investors interested in the project to visit the NCP website at www.ncp.gov.sa to learn more about the project and request the RFQ document. All interested companies should submit their SOQ by November 14, 2024 at 3:00 pm KSA time. Share | Print
